A 64 x 32 PSD whose layers all blend normal (a pass-through group at 90 % holding a masked card at 80 % with a clipped shine at 50 %; an isolated group at 70 % of two overlapping half-transparent squares; a dot), written with psd-tools.
Converted by pelican-import-tools: `uv run pelican-import-tools psd-canvas fixture.psd <out> --asset-prefix project://imports/psd_fixture`; reference.png is psd-tools' composite of the PSD.
Kept here: canvas.graph.json, layers/, masks/, reference.png (not the PSD, the script, manifest.json or canvas.report.json).
